mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in restrictive monetary policy periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
